description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 要扩容数据卷的ECI实例ID，即容器组ID。
description.en: The ID of the ECI instance that has the volume to resize. This is the container group ID.

description.zh:
扩容后的云盘容量大小。单位为GiB。取值范围：

- 高效云盘（cloud_efficiency）：20~32768
- SSD云盘（cloud_ssd）：20~32768
- ESSD云盘（cloud_essd）：20~32768
- 普通云盘（cloud）：5~2000

> 扩容后的云盘容量必须大于原有云盘容量。如果扩容指定的容量与原有云盘容量一致，则仅扩容文件系统。
description.en:
The new size of the disk after it is resized. Unit: GiB. Valid values:

- ultra disk (cloud\_efficiency): 20 to 32768

- standard SSD (cloud\_ssd): 20 to 32768

- ESSD (cloud\_essd): 20 to 32768

- basic disk (cloud): 5 to 2000

> The new disk size must be larger than the original disk size. If the new size is the same as the original size, only the file system is resized.

description.zh: ECI实例挂载的数据卷名称。目前仅支持扩容云盘。
description.en: The name of the volume that is mounted to the ECI instance. You can resize only disks.

descriptions.zh:
##  接口说明

- 该接口仅支持扩容数据卷，不支持缩容数据卷。
- 目前仅支持扩容云盘类型的数据卷，暂不支持扩容其他类型的数据卷。
descriptions.en:
## Description

- This operation supports only scaling out volumes. Scaling in is not supported.

- You can scale out only disk volumes. Other volume types are not supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci resize-container-group-volume --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --container-group-id eci-2zelg8vwnlzdhf8hv0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --volume-name default-volume1 --new-size 100 --region cn-hangzhou
